name: Statutory Minimum Wage Rate Floor Check
description: Verifies that every employee's daily wage rate is equal to or greater than the statutory floor wage (minimum ₹450/day).

name: Statutory Overtime Double Rate Verification
description: Verifies that all overtime hours are remunerated at not less than twice the normal hourly wage rate.

name: Statutory Maximum 50% Deduction Ceiling
description: Verifies that aggregate statutory deductions do not exceed 50% of total gross wages earned in any wage period.

name: Maximum Daily (8 hrs) and Weekly (48 hrs) Hours Ceiling
description: Ensures no worker is required or allowed to work for more than 8 hours in any day or 48 hours in any week without compensatory rest and overtime authorization.

name: Timely Wage Disbursement within Statutory Deadline
description: Verifies that wages are disbursed before the expiry of the seventh day or tenth day of the succeeding month.

name: Mandatory Statutory Registers Maintenance (Form A, B, D)
description: Ensures establishment maintains Form A (Register of Employees), Form B (Register of Wages), and Form D (Muster Roll / Attendance).

name: Mandatory Bi-partite Safety Committee Constitution
description: Verifies that factories employing 250+ workers (or 100+ for hazardous manufacturing) constitute an active Safety Committee with equal worker representation.
